document.name: CONFIGURATION_AND_SETTINGS_AUDIT
document.author: Principal Product Architect & Principal Rust Engineer

verdict.summary: M31A passes all functional execution gates and 51 test suites, but configuration authority is fragmented: runtime execution completely bypasses AppConfig and ProviderRegistry, slash commands are echo-only pseudo-commands, deterministic verification assumes Cargo repositories, and the P0 unprunable safety prompt hardcodes a specific arithmetic calculator solution into every mission.

sources.status: Read/written by cli config, ignored by runtime

settings.name: provider
settings.notes: ProviderRegistry supports 5 providers, but dispatcher hardcodes direct NvidiaProvider instantiation.

settings.name: model
settings.notes: AppConfig specifies claude-3-5-sonnet, model_policy.rs specifies llama-3.2-11b, /model command is echo-only.

settings.name: endpoint_base_url
settings.notes: Controls outbound network egress endpoint for model inferences.

settings.name: api_key
settings.notes: Must never be placed in config.toml; must always be masked in logs, TUI, and traces.

settings.name: autonomy_mode
settings.notes: Conflated with ProfileConfig. Only 5 mode strings recognized; passing execution profile names defaults to Safe.

settings.name: execution_profile
settings.notes: Contains 7 rich profiles, but bypassed by runtime. /profile command is echo-only.

settings.name: agent_role_profile
settings.default: Planner, Architect, Researcher, Implementer, Verifier, Reviewer, Doctor, SecurityAuditor
settings.notes: Planning service hardcodes only Implementer role in planner prompt generation.

settings.name: approval_policy
settings.notes: EffectivePolicy path searches .m31/ instead of .m31a/.

settings.name: max_agent_steps
settings.notes: Hardcoded step ceiling prevents tuning for micro-tasks or massive refactors.

settings.name: max_retries
settings.notes: ResourceBudget defaults to None, creating risk of unbounded recovery loops.

settings.name: token_budget
settings.notes: AppConfig specifies max_tokens 8192 for agents, but BudgetEnforcer receives None.

settings.name: context_window_limit
settings.notes: Model context window is property of model architecture, should come from ProviderRegistry.

settings.name: tool_output_limit
settings.current_source: Hardcoded 4000 chars in compiler.rs; 10MB in limits.rs
settings.notes: Compiler truncates tool output at 4000 chars to protect context window.

settings.name: filesystem_policy
settings.default: Deny secrets, deny dotfiles outside workspace, deny traversal
settings.notes: Must NEVER be configurable or overridable by user, workspace, or profile.

settings.name: network_policy
settings.notes: Defaults to Ask for all outbound network connections; can be tightened to Deny.

settings.name: worktree_dir
settings.notes: AppConfig.git.worktree_dir exists in schema but is ignored by WorktreeConfig.

settings.name: git_commit_trailers
settings.notes: Audit attribution invariant: commits made by M31A must record provenance.

settings.name: git_auto_commit
settings.notes: Defined in AppConfig schema but never referenced in Git workflow.

settings.name: git_push_policy
settings.notes: Defined in AppConfig schema but never checked during git push execution.

settings.name: tui_theme
settings.notes: ThemeMode supports 4 themes, but draw loop hardcodes DarkSlateCyan.

settings.name: tui_target_fps
settings.notes: TuiApp::new hardcodes 60 FPS; schema specifies 30 FPS.

settings.name: tui_keybindings
settings.notes: No keybinding remapping table exists.

settings.name: concurrency_limit
settings.notes: Three different values configured in three different subsystems.

settings.name: session_retention
settings.notes: Sessions and messages accumulate indefinitely in SQLite without pruning.

settings.name: verification_pipeline_commands
settings.default: cargo check, cargo test, cargo clippy
settings.notes: Unconditionally fails closed on non-Rust repositories.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcoded arithmetic parser instructions and solution in P0 safety prompt
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Every agent prompt contains instructions to write parse_expression in src/parser.rs
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Corrupts prompt context for all non-calculator missions.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: /model <name> returns success string without updating active model
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: User believes model changed; runtime continues using previous model
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Declared CommandSideEffect::ReadOnly.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: /profile <name> returns success string without updating profile
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: User believes profile changed; runtime continues using previous profile
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Declared CommandSideEffect::ReadOnly.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: cli.config flag is completely ignored; never loaded into any config parser
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: User passes --config custom.toml; completely ignored
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Flag is defined in Clap but variable is unused.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: AppRuntime never reads AppConfig, config.toml, or ConfigurationService
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: All runtime subsystems initialized with hardcoded builder defaults
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Disconnects entire configuration engine from execution.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Verification unconditionally requires Cargo.toml and src/ directory
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Non-Rust repositories immediately fail closed at Tier 1
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Breaks non-Rust repository support.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Compiler command hardcoded to "cargo check"
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Assumes Rust workspace; fails on Python/Go/TS
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Must be driven by project type.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Test command hardcoded to "cargo test"
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Assumes Rust workspace
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Must be driven by project type.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Linter command hardcoded to "cargo clippy -- -D warnings"
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Assumes Rust workspace
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Must be driven by project type.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes model fallback "meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct", context 131072, provider "nvidia"
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Ignores AppConfig.agents.default_model (claude-3-5-sonnet)
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Provider and model fallback hardcoded in struct constructor.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Directly instantiates NvidiaProvider; ignores ProviderRegistry
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Cannot switch to OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Ollama
hardcoded_decisions.notes: ProviderRegistry is completely bypassed in production dispatcher.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes policy paths to /etc/m31/policy.toml, <ws>/.m31/policy.toml, ~/.config/m31/policy.toml
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Uses .m31 instead of .m31a; diverges from PlatformPaths
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Typo in folder name splits configuration across two directories.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Uses ProjectDirs::from("com", "m31a", "M31A") while config/paths.rs uses "m31a"
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Case mismatch causes divergent directories on macOS/Windows
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Diverges on case-sensitive or case-preserving filesystems.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes theme to ThemeTokens::resolve(ThemeMode::DarkSlateCyan) during draw
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Ignores AppConfig.tui.theme and user preferences
hardcoded_decisions.notes: User has no way to switch TUI theme.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes target FPS to 60, whereas AppConfig.tui.fps defaults to 30
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Disagrees with schema default
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Doubles CPU draw cycle frequency.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: View 34 renders static hardcoded string instead of SettingsScreen
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: User views dummy text; SettingsScreen is dead code
hardcoded_decisions.notes: View 34 is not wired to the existing SettingsScreen implementation.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Budget enforcer hardcoded to ResourceBudget::default() (all limits None)
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Missions run completely unbounded unless profile sets limits
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Unbounded execution risk.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes ResourceManager worker pool capacity to 1
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Overrides ConcurrencyLimits (which allows 8 global workers)
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Serializes all agent executions even when concurrency is requested.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes global workers = 8, role limits (Implementer: 4, Architect: 2, etc.)
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Disagrees with AppConfig.runtime.concurrency_limit = 4
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Three different concurrency numbers across subsystems.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes worktree directory to .m31a/worktrees
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Ignores AppConfig.git.worktree_dir
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Schema setting ignored.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: auto_commit: bool and push_policy: String are defined in schema but never read
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Settings exist in config schema but have zero consumers
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Dead configuration fields in schema.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: ToolFilter exists with full unit tests but is never invoked by runner/dispatcher
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: denied_tools in AppConfig has no effect on tool execution
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Policy bypass: denied tools can still be executed if requested.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Planner prompt hardcodes only one available role: Implementer
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Multi-agent collaboration disabled during model planning
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Suppresses multi-agent roles during planning.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Max SQLite connections hardcoded to 5, busy timeout to 30s
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Cannot tune DB pool for high concurrency or slow disks
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Reasonable defaults, but untunable.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes foreground timeout to 30s, grace period to 1000ms
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Long compile steps hit foreground timeout
hardcoded_decisions.notes: May abort long builds prematurely.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Capacity hardcoded to 2048
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Adequate, but cannot be tuned
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Internal ring buffer sizing.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes 32 KB max file bytes, 50 max directory entries
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Good protection, but cannot be tuned per workspace
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Limits size of @file context inclusions.

hardcoded_decisions.hardcoded_decision: Hardcodes 1 GiB memory, 256 open files, 10 MiB output
hardcoded_decisions.current_behavior: Good defaults, but unable to override for large builds
hardcoded_decisions.notes: Sandbox limits should be tunable per profile.

duplicate_authorities.remedy: Wire ProviderRegistry to determine model descriptors and active profile defaults.
ProviderRegistry must be instantiated in AppRuntime and passed into ProductionWorkerDispatcher.
Reconcile path resolution in EffectivePolicy to point to canonical .m31a/ directory.
Eliminate hardcoded default in scheduler; read limit from resolved RuntimeConfig.
Pass concurrency limit into ResourceManager constructor instead of hardcoding 1.
TuiApp::new must read target_fps from resolved TuiConfig.

duplicate_authorities.authority_a: AppConfig: Strongly typed nested TOML tables (src/config/schema.rs)
duplicate_authorities.remedy: m31a config get/set must parse and serialize against the typed AppConfig schema.
Unify all ProjectDirs instantiations to lowercase "m31a".

security_invariants.name: Mandatory Path Confinement
security_invariants.description: Prevents file reads, writes, and directory listings outside workspace boundaries and sandbox root.

security_invariants.name: Secret Redaction & Masking
security_invariants.description: Telemetry and event streams must redact API keys, private keys, bearer tokens, and credentials.

security_invariants.name: Monotonic Policy Restriction Floor
security_invariants.description: Higher precedence layers (workspace, user, CLI) can only restrict permissions, never bypass system invariants.

security_invariants.name: Mandatory RFC 2822 Git Attribution Trailers
security_invariants.description: All git commits produced by autonomous missions must record immutable M31A-Mission and M31A-Task trailers.

security_invariants.name: Non-Bypassable 11-Stage Tool Execution Pipeline
security_invariants.description: Every tool call must traverse all pipeline stages including rate limiting, policy gating, validation, and redaction.

security_invariants.name: Durable Event Bus Audit Integrity
security_invariants.description: Lifecycle events and policy evaluations must be durably emitted to SQLite event audit store.

sections.description: Terminal user interface appearance and performance

phases.name: Configuration Engine Wiring
phases.action: Wire AppRuntime::from_pool_and_workspace to load resolved AppConfig via ConfigPrecedenceEngine without breaking existing defaults.

phases.name: P0 Invariants & Pseudo-Commands Fix
phases.action: Clean hardcoded calculator instructions from context/compiler.rs, wire /model and /profile slash commands, and connect View 34 to SettingsScreen.

phases.name: Multi-Language Project Adapters
phases.action: Generalize DeterministicRunner and CompilerRunner to read commands from [workspace.verification].

phases.name: Path Deprecation and Secret Cleanup
phases.action: Deprecate .m31/ policy paths in favor of .m31a/ and ensure .env credentials seamlessly populate credentials.json.

implementation_order: Phase A: Clean P0 Prompts & Detach Fixture Code (context/compiler.rs)
Phase B: Platform Paths & Policy Path Reconciliation (.m31 -> .m31a, lowercase singleton)
Phase C: Authoritative Configuration Service Assembly (Wire AppConfig into AppRuntime)
Phase D: ProviderRegistry & Model Routing Plumb-Through (Wire dispatcher & slash commands)
Phase E: Verification Project Adapters (Multi-language verification)
Phase F: TUI Settings Screen & Command Routing (Wire View 34 to SettingsScreen)

contradictions.contradiction: TRD §D-08 specifies multi-provider model routing (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Nvidia, Local), but production dispatcher hardcodes NvidiaProvider directly.
UI/UX Spec §34 specifies a full settings and provenance screen (View 34), but implementation renders a static 3-line placeholder string.
TRD §D-14 specifies policy paths in .m31a/policy.toml, but executable code searches .m31/policy.toml.
AppConfig schema specifies claude-3-5-sonnet as default model, but model_policy.rs and env.rs fall back to meta/llama-3.2-11b-vision-instruct.
